mapper.select: SELECT FII.STD_YYYY AS stdYyyy ,FII.EXW_RATE AS exwRate ,FII.FCA_RATE AS fcaRate ,FII.FAS_RATE AS fasRate ,FII.FOB_RATE AS fobRate ,FII.CFR_RATE AS cfrRate ,FII.CIF_RATE AS cifRate ,FII.CPT_RATE AS cptRate ,FII.CIP_RATE AS cipRate ,FII.DAP_RATE AS dapRate ,FII.DPU_RATE AS dpuRate ,FII.DDP_RATE AS ddpRate FROM FTA_INCOTERMS_INFO FII WHERE FII.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND FII.DIVISION_CODE = #{divisionCode} AND FII.INCOTERMS_TYPE = #{exportFlag} AND FII.NATION_CODE = #{nationCode} AND FII.STD_YYYY <= #{stdYyyy} ORDER BY FII.STD_YYYY DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
